title: RadioEvent
description: Structured operational event extracted from one radio transcript by the Radio Intelligence Agent.

event_id.description: Unique identifier of this radio event.

audio_id.description: Identifier of the source audio message.

unit_id.description: Identified speaking unit (e.g. alpha-3), null if unknown.

event_type.description: Category of the extracted operational event.

location_reference.description: Location mentioned in the message (e.g. hangar, D17), null if none.

facts.description: Atomic facts extracted from the message.

confirmation_status.description: Whether the fact is reported, inferred, or field-confirmed.

is_correction.description: True if this event corrects a previous event.

corrects_event_id.description: Identifier of the corrected event, null if not a correction.

uncertainties.description: Open uncertainties attached to this event.

evidence_text.description: Exact transcript span supporting this event.
